derivation.expression: ba220-assets-bought-in-fold for line R0010, Historic cost to date dimension

dataRequirements.description: The ba220-assets-bought-in-fold supplies the Historic cost to date value for Companies - Total / Historic cost to date.
GL trial-balance fold supplies the GL balances Companies - Total / Historic cost to date aggregates.

A credit product feeding Companies - Total / Historic cost to date must carry its assetBoughtInFlag: whether the asset was bought-in / acquired by the bank (e.g. in satisfaction of a debt) — the defining attribute of every BA 220 line. A credit product feeding Companies - Total / Historic cost to date must carry its boughtInAssetType: the bought-in asset type — company shareholding vs immovable property — which selects the BA 220 Companies vs ImmovableAssets sub-form. (SARB reg 23; Banks Act s.78.)

cells.statusReason: Assets-bought-in figures require the bank to have acquired companies or immovable property (e.g. in satisfaction of a debt); the bank-in-formation holds none pre-licence-day.
